en: This is a black-and-white image showing a dockside scene with a large steamboat labeled 'Express II' moored at the quay. There are people and cargo on the dock, with some picturesque buildings in the background, which appear to be in the Scandinavian architectural style. The sky is partly cloudy, and the water in the foreground is rippling. There is printed text in Swedish at the bottom of the postcard.
